What actually counts as SDI in math? Find out May 19! 

In this session, you'll explore what Specially Designed Instruction really looks like in a math classroom—from adapting content and methodology to delivering explicit, multisensory instruction that meets students where they are. 

Reserve your spot today:  https://hubs.ly/Q04dVM-P0

#Math #TouchMath # SDI

Accommodations are important—but they're not SDI. And when it comes to math instruction for students with disabilities, knowing the difference can change everything. 

Join TouchMath® and our friends at CASE on May 19 at 3:30 PM ET for a practical, eye-opening webinar: "What counts as SDI in math? Moving beyond accommodations." 

Seats are limited. Register now:  https://hubs.ly/Q04dScW70
